release_notes:
Release v1.4.0 - 2026-11-21

📚 Documentation:
  • docs: one JSON document per fence in read-only-access, cli.md links shell completion, status.md names the Intel Mac limit (A-77), five languages [skip release]
  • docs checks: the a11y check expects pipx install in the first install block; the CLI example check knows selftest and completion [skip release]
  • docs: cli.md lists selftest and completion, five languages [skip release]
  • docs: troubleshooting and status for v1.4.0 (Permissions line, throttling and Ctrl-C with the limiter, caveats), regenerated sample blocks, in five languages [skip release]
  • docs: Concurrency section, --concurrency in the CLI reference and the configuration pages, parallel credential check, in five languages [skip release]
  • docs: Run with only ReadOnlyAccess (what works, the three actions it lacks, the Permissions line and permissions_denied, provisional policy list), the details_not_compared sentence, and the guard and debug-log limits (A-74, A-76), in five languages [skip release]
  • docs: three missing caveats (expired-session error code, S3 bucket in another region, expired SSO token message) and the sentences for the subnet columns, raw_data size, modules planned for removal and the launchers, in five languages [skip release]
  • docs: examples name the development script by its real path; shipped service descriptions and tag mappings files load with no warning; examples README says what the accounts files do (C-12, D-10, D-11) [skip release]
  • docs: release runbook page in five languages: the release rules, each with its test, the known limits, the recovery when the tag push fails, the post-release checklist (C-05, P-16, CI9) [skip release]
  • docs versioning: commit the translated current-version labels (current.json) after each release; refresh them to v1.2.2 (C-06) [skip release]
  • docs-deploy: remove the three steps that run docs-migration JavaScript (D-06) [skip release]
  • docs-deploy: shellcheck style findings in run blocks (quote the GitHub file variables, grouped redirects, read -r) [skip release]
  • docs-deploy: the accessibility server wait loop does not name an unused variable (SC2034) [skip release]
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.3.1 [skip release]

⚡ Performance Improvements:
  • performance: the weekly workflow also runs the slow regression tests (-m slow, tests/regression) (architect order F2) [skip release]
